description: Dispatches one or more physical clicks at a page-viewport CSS coordinate. Coordinates do not scroll, resolve semantic targets, or recover stale targets; two clicks use the native double-click gesture and larger counts run bounded sequential clicks.

pageId.description: Page ID that receives the click sequence.

x.description: Horizontal page-viewport coordinate in CSS pixels.

y.description: Vertical page-viewport coordinate in CSS pixels.

clickCount.description: Number of clicks to dispatch, from 1 to 100.

purpose.description: Describe the intended page effect at this exact viewport coordinate, such as activating a visual control that has no stable locator.

pageId.description: Page that received the click sequence.

x.description: Horizontal page-viewport coordinate in CSS pixels.

y.description: Vertical page-viewport coordinate in CSS pixels.

point.description: Coordinate used for every dispatched click.

clickCount.description: Requested click count, present only when the full sequence completed.

dialog.description: Interactive native dialog returned while dispatching the sequence.

id.description: ID of an interactive native dialog returned for Page.handleDialog.

message.description: Dialog message supplied by the page.

defaultValue.description: Default value for a prompt dialog.

truncated.description: Whether native dialog text was truncated.

observation.description: Facts directly observed by the Action or returned by its declared result schema.

suggested_prompt.description: Guidance to re-observe current state and choose the next operation.

details.description: Only fields listed by the public error definition detailFields are returned; private execution diagnostics are omitted.
